results.prompt: 请用中文将这句话改写得更正式，保留所有事实、金额、币种、姓名和日期，只输出改写后的句子：Alex 将于 2026-10-08 支付 1,250 EUR。

results.prompt: Summarize in one English sentence without adding facts: Alex proposed a payment of 1,250 EUR on 2026-10-08. The payment has NOT been approved. Do not claim that the payment is approved or scheduled.
results.output: Alex proposed a payment of 1,250 EUR on 2026-10-08, but it has not yet been approved.
